# 📚 Student Attendance Management System

A **Full Stack Mobile Application** developed using **React Native (Expo), Node.js, Express.js, and MySQL** to simplify student attendance management through an easy-to-use mobile interface.

---

## ✨ Features

- 🔐 User Authentication
- 👨‍🎓 Add Student
- 📋 View Student List
- ✏️ Edit Student Details
- 🗑️ Delete Student
- ✅ Mark Attendance
- 📅 Attendance History
- 🔳 QR Code Generation
- 📷 QR Code Scanner
- 💾 MySQL Database Integration

---

## 🛠️ Tech Stack

### Frontend
- React Native
- Expo
- JavaScript

### Backend
- Node.js
- Express.js
- REST API

### Database
- MySQL

### Tools
- VS Code
- Git
- GitHub
- Postman

## 🚀 Installation

### Clone the Repository

```bash
git clone https://github.com/kaviya-btech/student-attendance-management-system.git
```

### Install Dependencies

```bash
npm install
```

### Start the Backend

```bash
node server.js
```

### Start the Frontend

```bash
npx expo start
```
